public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Cache Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Arpit Dwivedi that has raised $8.5M to date. The sector comp universe consists of 9 private peers and 1 public company (LNZA), including notable players such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total raised ($8.5M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $21M. The peer-median method is not applicable because the Climate & Energy sector contains insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds—while 9 same-sector peers exist, none cluster tightly enough in stage or valuation tier to support reliable median benchmarking without risking distortion.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $18M (low) to $24M (high), with a median of $21M. This range reflects disciplined application of stage-based progression methodology but is constrained by limited peer comparability at the Seed stage. Key uncertainties include the absence of a robust narrow-peer dataset and dependence on a single methodological input, which leaves the valuation sensitive to the reasonableness of the 2.5x multiplier assumption and actual market conditions for follow-on funding in climate-tech.
